stem.text: The graph shows the variation of the first ionisation energy with proton number for some elements. The letters used are **not** the actual symbols for the elements.

stem.alt: Graph of first ionisation energy (y-axis) against proton number (x-axis). Points are labelled P, Q, R, S, T, U, V, W and X. P and X are peaks, Q is a minimum, and the trend has a sawtooth pattern with a general rise.

stem.text: Which statement about the elements is correct?

A.text: P and X are in the same period in the Periodic Table.

B.text: The general increase from Q to X is due to increasing atomic radius.

C.text: The small decrease from R to S is due to decreased shielding.

D.text: The small decrease from U to V is due to repulsion between paired electrons.
